'''2017 European Championship Day 2 Julian Smolarek DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Julian Smolarek]] at [[2017 European Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Player:''' [[Julian Smolarek]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 European Championship]]
